name: voice-intelligence-platform
description: Multilingual (English / Hindi / Hinglish) AI Voice Intelligence Platform: pnpm + Turborepo monorepo (ADR-0005).

scripts.infra:up: docker compose -f infra/docker/compose.yaml --env-file .env up -d --wait postgres redis
scripts.audio:test:container: docker build -f services/audio/Dockerfile --target test -t vip-audio-test services/audio && docker run --rm --init --read-only --cap-drop ALL --security-opt no-new-privileges --pids-limit 64 --memory 512m --cpus 1 --tmpfs /tmp:size=64m,noexec,nosuid,nodev -v "$PWD/packages/contracts:/contracts:ro" vip-audio-test pytest -p no:cacheprovider -s -q
scripts.audio:lint: uv run --directory services/audio ruff check . && uv run --directory services/audio ruff format --check . && uv run --directory services/audio mypy
